basis.en: Public domain: the artist died in 1509. The Metropolitan Museum of Art releases this image under CC0 through its Open Access programme.
basis.zh: 公有领域：作者卒于 1509 年。大都会艺术博物馆通过开放获取计划以 CC0 发布此图像。

alt.en: Pale grey ink mountains, soft with mist, rise above a stand of tall thin trees and a quiet bank in the lower part of the scroll. Lines of poetry fill the paper above the painting, with a second inscription at the right.
alt.zh: 淡灰的水墨山峦笼着雾气，耸立在画幅下部一丛高瘦的树和一段安静的河岸之上。画面上方的纸上写满诗句，右侧还有另一段题字。

note.en: Shen Zhou, founder of the Wu school of Suzhou, painted this at fifty; the title records a night moored in the rain. The whole picture is wet: ink is laid on in soft washes and dabs, and the mountains seem to dissolve into the air. Being held in place by the weather, with time to look, is a good condition for a painting.
note.zh: 沈周是苏州吴门画派的开创者，画这幅时五十岁；题目记下的是雨夜泊舟的一晚。整幅画都是湿的：墨用柔和的渲染和点子铺开，山仿佛溶进了空气里。被天气困在原地、反而有了时间去看——这是作画的好处境。
